env.name: OPKSSH_VERSION
env.description: Use another opkssh release than the one Termix pins. Needs OPKSSH_SHA256 too.

env.name: OPKSSH_SHA256

env.name: OPKSSH_SHA256_AMD64
env.description: SHA-256 of the x64 binary for OPKSSH_VERSION.

env.name: OPKSSH_SHA256_ARM64
env.description: SHA-256 of the ARM64 binary for OPKSSH_VERSION.

env.name: OPKSSH_BUNDLED_DIR
env.description: Folder with a copy of opkssh baked into the image, used before downloading.

env.name: GUACD_HOST
env.description: Host guacd listens on. Overrides the guacd URL setting.

env.name: GUACD_PORT
env.description: Port guacd listens on.

env.name: GUACD_URL
env.description: guacd as host:port, in place of GUACD_HOST and GUACD_PORT.

env.name: GUACD_TUNNEL_HOST
env.description: Address guacd uses to reach Termix for hosts behind jump hosts and VNC without a username. In Compose, the Termix container name. In Kubernetes it defaults to the pod IP.

env.name: GUACD_RECORDING_PATH
env.description: Folder guacd writes recordings to, as guacd sees it.

env.name: GUACD_RECORDING_BACKEND_PATH
env.description: The same folder as Termix sees it.

env.name: GUACD_DRIVE_PATH
env.description: Folder guacd keeps RDP drive files in. Each user gets a folder under it.

env.name: GUACAMOLE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: Key that encrypts connection tokens, 64 hex characters. Made for you on each start if not set. Set it when you run more than one Termix server.

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.description: Redis that several Termix servers share for meeting rooms, like redis://redis:6379. Not needed with one server.

env.name: TERMIX_REDIS_PREFIX
env.description: Prefix for the keys it writes in Redis.

name: Single sign-on

author: Termix

env.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID of an OIDC provider set from the environment. Needs the next four too.

env.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Its client secret.

env.name: OIDC_ISSUER_URL
env.description: Its issuer URL.

env.name: OIDC_AUTHORIZATION_URL
env.description: Its authorization endpoint.

env.name: OIDC_TOKEN_URL
env.description: Its token endpoint.

env.name: OIDC_USERINFO_URL
env.description: Its userinfo endpoint, if it is not the usual one.

env.name: OIDC_IDENTIFIER_PATH
env.description: Claim that identifies a user.

env.name: OIDC_NAME_PATH
env.description: Claim used as the Termix username.

env.name: OIDC_SCOPES
env.description: Scopes to ask for.

env.name: OIDC_ALLOWED_USERS
env.description: Emails allowed to sign in, comma separated. Empty allows everyone.

env.name: OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP
env.description: Members of this group are admins.

env.name: OIDC_GROUP_CLAIM
env.description: Claim with the groups, if not groups, roles or group.

env.name: OIDC_ROLE_MAP
env.description: Groups to Termix roles as group:role pairs, comma separated. Works for every OIDC provider, not just this one.

env.name: OIDC_ENV_OVERRIDE
env.description: true makes the provider above the only one, even when providers are set up in the app.

env.name: OIDC_LEGACY_CALLBACK
env.description: false makes the provider above send the new redirect URI, /plugin-api/sso/callback, instead of the 2.8 one, /users/oidc/callback.

env.name: OIDC_SILENT_LOGIN_DEFAULT
env.description: true or false. Sends visitors straight to SSO, and locks the setting.
